title: Naturality of all represented affine residue arrows
statement: Let E be a derived object on W, represented over an affine open U containing w by a strictly perfect K and a specified isomorphism m: restriction(E) ~= Q(K). Let p=ker(evaluation). There exists one additive comparison eK from affineResidueCycleHomology(K) to derivedFiberCohomology(E). For every E prime, arrow b:E->E prime, strict perfect model C and specified m prime, there exists a target comparison eC such that eC(residueHomologyMap(phi,z))=derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor(b)(eK(z)) for every phi with Q(phi)=m.inv;restriction(b);m prime.hom. The source comparison is fixed before the target or arrow is chosen.

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Compose the natural quotient/evaluation comparison with the natural perfect derived-model comparison. This fixes the model-to-local-fibre comparison on every strictly perfect object and arrow.

Conjugate by the specified model isomorphisms and compose with the natural open-factorization isomorphism. Substitute the equality for Q(phi), cancel m prime.hom followed by m prime.inv, and apply factorization naturality to b. Evaluation of this categorical square gives the elementwise equation for every representative.

lean.statement: theorem affine_residue_model_naturality [∀ Y : Scheme.{v}, HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))] (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W) (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (p : Ideal Γ(W, U)) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p = RingHom.ker (W.evaluation U w hwU).hom) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K) (m : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) : ∃ eK : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E 1 w, ∀ (E' : schemeDerivedCategory W) (b : E ⟶ E') (C : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ) (_hC : IsStrictlyPerfect W U C) (m' : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E' ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C), ∃ eC : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p C ≃+ derivedFiberCohomology W E' 1 w, ∀ (φ : K ⟶ C), DerivedCategory.Q.map φ = m.inv ≫ (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map b ≫ m'.hom → ∀ z : affineResidueCycleHomology W U p K, eC (affineResidueCycleHomologyMap φ z) = (derivedFiberCohomologyFunctor W w 1).map b (eK z)
